description: This file defines the final class ConfigTarget in the Drupal namespace, which maps configuration properties to form elements, including methods for creating instances from strings or form arrays, retrieving and setting config values, and handling multiple property paths.

classes.name: ConfigTarget
classes.description: Represents the mapping of a config property to a form element, with methods for instantiation, value retrieval, and value setting, supporting multiple property paths and transformations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ConfigTarget object with config name, property paths, and optional transformation callbacks.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a ConfigTarget instance from a string in the format 'CONFIG_NAME:PROPERTY_PATH'.

methods.name: fromForm
methods.description: Retrieves a ConfigTarget object from a form array element, using the '#config_target' property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and transforms the value from the config object based on the mapping.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value in the config object based on the form submission, applying transformations and handling special cases.

methods.name: isMultiTarget
methods.description: Checks if the ConfigTarget targets multiple property paths.
